title: 语法 · 非谓语｜不定式与动名词 · 60 句
description: 动词补足形式、stop/remember/try/mean 的意义变化、主语评价、使役及用途。

items.zh: 他们决定把入口移到背风的一侧。
items.en: They decided to move the entrance to the sheltered side.
answers: They decided to move the entrance to the sheltered side.
items.notes: decide to do，不用 decide doing。

items.zh: 我设法从裂缝里取出了卡片。
items.en: I managed to retrieve the card from the crack.
answers: I managed to retrieve the card from the crack.
items.notes: manage to do 表成功做到，不只是尝试。

items.zh: 她拒绝在看过样品之前批准印刷。
items.en: She refused to approve printing before seeing a sample.
answers: She refused to approve printing before seeing a sample.
items.notes: refuse to do；before 后用 seeing。

items.zh: 我们希望能在开放前完成照明测试。
items.en: We hope to finish testing the lighting before opening.
answers: We hope to finish testing the lighting before opening.
items.notes: hope to do；finish 后接 testing，两种补足形式不同。

items.zh: 那位歌手似乎还不知道节目有变。
items.en: The singer appears to be unaware of the programme change.
answers: The singer appears to be unaware of the programme change.
items.notes: appear to be + 形容词表观察判断；unaware of：不知道。

items.zh: 请安排在安静的房间里进行录音。
items.en: Please arrange to record in a quiet room.
answers: Please arrange to record in a quiet room.
items.notes: arrange to do；不定式说明安排做的动作。

items.zh: 我没能让门锁重新正常工作。
items.en: I failed to get the lock working again.
answers: I failed to get the lock working again.
items.notes: fail to do；get + 宾语 + working 表使恢复运转。

items.zh: 我们不能承受丢失唯一原件的风险。
items.en: We cannot afford to lose the sole original.
answers: We cannot afford to lose the sole original.
We can't afford to lose the sole original.
items.notes: afford to do 表承受某行为后果，不限金钱。

items.zh: 他主动提出陪我们去核对地址。
items.en: He offered to accompany us to verify the address.
answers: He offered to accompany us to verify the address.
items.notes: offer to do 表主动提议；第二个 to 表目的。

items.zh: 承包方同意更换所有破损的地砖。
items.en: The contractor agreed to replace every cracked tile.
answers: The contractor agreed to replace every cracked tile.
items.notes: agree to do，区别 agree with someone。

items.zh: 我很享受把碎片重新拼成图案的过程。
items.en: I enjoy fitting the fragments back into a pattern.
answers: I enjoy fitting the fragments back into a pattern.
items.notes: enjoy 后接 doing，不接 to do。

items.zh: 他们考虑把旧门改成一张桌子。
items.en: They considered turning the old door into a table.
answers: They considered turning the old door into a table.
items.notes: consider doing：考虑做，而不是认为某人是什么。

items.zh: 请避免在接缝处施加压力。
items.en: Avoid applying pressure to the seam.
answers: Avoid applying pressure to the seam.
items.notes: avoid doing；apply pressure to：向某处施压。

items.zh: 我不介意重做封面，但希望保留正文。
items.en: I do not mind redoing the cover, but I want to retain the text.
answers: I do not mind redoing the cover, but I want to retain the text.
I don't mind redoing the cover, but I want to retain the text.
items.notes: mind doing；want to do，两者补足形式不同。

items.zh: 工程师建议减少连接点的数量。
items.en: The engineer suggested reducing the number of joints.
answers: The engineer suggested reducing the number of joints.
items.notes: suggest doing，不用 suggest to do。

items.zh: 我们推迟了给门框进行最后打磨的工作。
items.en: We postponed giving the doorframe its final sanding.
answers: We postponed giving the doorframe its final sanding.
items.notes: postpone doing：推迟某动作；final 明确修饰打磨步骤。

items.zh: 他承认把两个编号抄反了。
items.en: He admitted reversing the two numbers when copying them.
answers: He admitted reversing the two numbers when copying them.
items.notes: admit doing：承认做过；reverse：颠倒。

items.zh: 他们否认曾向公众开放过这个通道。
items.en: They denied opening the passage to the public.
answers: They denied opening the passage to the public.
items.notes: deny doing 表否认行为，不用 deny to do。

items.zh: 我们已经完成了对每个按钮的标记。
items.en: We have finished labelling every button.
answers: We have finished labelling every button.
items.notes: finish doing 表完成动作；没有 finish to label。

items.zh: 我想象过在这样的小房间里排练会是什么样。
items.en: I imagined rehearsing in such a small room.
answers: I imagined rehearsing in such a small room.
items.notes: imagine doing：想象做某事。

items.zh: 停下搬箱子的工作，先来看看这个裂缝。
items.en: Stop moving the crates and look at this crack first.
answers: Stop moving the crates and look at this crack first.
items.notes: stop doing：停止正在进行的行为。

items.zh: 我们在门口停下来核对腕带。
items.en: We stopped to check wristbands at the entrance.
answers: We stopped to check wristbands at the entrance.
items.notes: stop to do：停下原先活动，去做另一件事。

items.zh: 我记得把收据夹在了说明书里。
items.en: I remember placing the receipt inside the manual.
answers: I remember placing the receipt inside the manual.
items.notes: remember doing：记得已经做过。

items.zh: 离开前记得关上天窗。
items.en: Remember to close the skylight before leaving.
answers: Remember to close the skylight before leaving.
items.notes: remember to do：记得去完成待办行为。

items.zh: 我忘了给钥匙贴标签，现在分不清哪把是哪把。
items.en: I forgot to label the keys and now cannot tell them apart.
answers: I forgot to label the keys and now cannot tell them apart.
I forgot to label the keys and now can't tell them apart.
items.notes: forget to do 表未做；tell apart：区分。

items.zh: 我永远不会忘记第一次触摸那块陨石。
items.en: I will never forget touching that meteorite for the first time.
answers: I will never forget touching that meteorite for the first time.
items.notes: forget doing 指忘记过去经历，与未完成任务不同。

items.zh: 不妨把插头倒过来试试，看看是否能接上。
items.en: Try turning the plug around to see whether it fits.
answers: Try turning the plug around to see whether it fits.
items.notes: try doing 表尝试一种解决方法。

items.zh: 他努力够到开关，却始终差一点。
items.en: He tried to reach the switch but fell just short.
answers: He tried to reach the switch but fell just short.
items.notes: try to do 表努力做，未保证成功。

items.zh: 保留整面墙意味着失去一部分展示空间。
items.en: Keeping the whole wall means losing some display space.
answers: Keeping the whole wall means losing some display space.
items.notes: mean doing：意味着产生某结果。

items.zh: 我本来打算给边缘上漆，却把它漏掉了。
items.en: I meant to paint the edges but overlooked them.
answers: I meant to paint the edges but overlooked them.
items.notes: mean to do：本打算做，不是“意味着”。

items.zh: 把每个步骤都拍下来需要额外时间。
items.en: Photographing every step takes extra time.
answers: Photographing every step takes extra time.
items.notes: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用 takes。

items.zh: 在这里安装坡道并不困难。
items.en: It is not difficult to install a ramp here.
answers: It is not difficult to install a ramp here.
It isn't difficult to install a ramp here.
items.notes: it 为形式主语，真正主语是不定式。

items.zh: 在未测量前就切割材料是浪费。
items.en: Cutting material before measuring it is wasteful.
answers: Cutting material before measuring it is wasteful.
items.notes: 动名词作主语；before 后也用动名词。

items.zh: 为了省一分钟而损坏样品并不值得。
items.en: It is not worth damaging a sample to save a minute.
answers: It is not worth damaging a sample to save a minute.
It isn't worth damaging a sample to save a minute.
items.notes: worth 后接 doing，不定式 to save 另表目的。

items.zh: 试图移动一块已经固定的板没有意义。
items.en: There is no point in trying to move a fixed panel.
answers: There is no point in trying to move a fixed panel.
items.notes: no point in doing；try to move 表试图做。

items.zh: 清楚地标出边界可以减少误解。
items.en: Marking boundaries clearly can reduce misunderstandings.
answers: Marking boundaries clearly can reduce misunderstandings.
items.notes: 动名词短语整体作主语；clearly 修饰 marking。

items.zh: 不戴手套处理这种材料是不明智的。
items.en: It is unwise to handle this material without gloves.
answers: It is unwise to handle this material without gloves.
items.notes: it is + 形容词 + to do，对行为作评价。

items.zh: 她主动把自己的位置让给别人，真是体贴。
items.en: It was considerate of her to give up her place.
answers: It was considerate of her to give up her place.
items.notes: 评价人的品质用 of someone，而非 for someone。

items.zh: 对视力较弱的人来说，分辨这些浅色很困难。
items.en: It is difficult for people with poor eyesight to distinguish these pale colours.
answers: It is difficult for people with poor eyesight to distinguish these pale colours.
items.notes: 说明行为对某人的难度用 for someone。

items.zh: 我们当前的首要任务是确定物件的来源。
items.en: Our immediate priority is to establish the object's origin.
answers: Our immediate priority is to establish the object's origin.
items.notes: 不定式作表语，说明待完成目标。

items.zh: 守卫要求我们出示箱子里的物品。
items.en: The guard asked us to show the contents of the case.
answers: The guard asked us to show the contents of the case.
items.notes: ask someone to do，宾语 us 是 show 的逻辑主语。

items.zh: 这块垫片能防止盖子完全合上。
items.en: The spacer prevents the lid from closing fully.
answers: The spacer prevents the lid from closing fully.
items.notes: prevent someone/something from doing，不用 to close。

items.zh: 我让助手把编号再读一遍。
items.en: I had the assistant read the numbers again.
answers: I had the assistant read the numbers again.
items.notes: have someone do 的 do 为原形，不带 to。

items.zh: 这段音效让观众转头看向后方。
items.en: The sound effect made the audience turn towards the back.
answers: The sound effect made the audience turn towards the back.
items.notes: make someone do 主动句用原形。

items.zh: 他们被要求从头重新填写表格。
items.en: They were made to complete the form again from the beginning.
answers: They were made to complete the form again from the beginning.
items.notes: make 被动结构恢复 to：be made to do。

items.zh: 请允许材料自然干燥。
items.en: Allow the material to dry naturally.
answers: Allow the material to dry naturally.
items.notes: allow something to do，与 let ... do 区分。

items.zh: 别让电池直接接触金属。
items.en: Do not let the battery touch bare metal.
answers: Do not let the battery touch bare metal.
Don't let the battery touch bare metal.
items.notes: let + 宾语 + 原形，不加 to。

items.zh: 标记能帮助使用者把零件正确对齐。
items.en: The marks help users align the parts correctly.
answers: The marks help users align the parts correctly.
The marks help users to align the parts correctly.
items.notes: help someone do，也可用 help someone to do。

items.zh: 我们说服店主保留了那块旧招牌。
items.en: We persuaded the owner to retain the old sign.
answers: We persuaded the owner to retain the old sign.
items.notes: persuade someone to do：说服某人做。

items.zh: 谁授权他们拆除这些支架的？
items.en: Who authorised them to remove these supports?
answers: Who authorised them to remove these supports?
items.notes: authorise someone to do；who 作疑问句主语。

items.zh: 我带了一块布来包住锋利的边缘。
items.en: I brought a cloth to wrap around the sharp edges.
answers: I brought a cloth to wrap around the sharp edges.
items.notes: to wrap 修饰 cloth，说明用途。

items.zh: 我们没有足够的夹子来固定整圈边框。
items.en: We lack enough clamps to secure the whole border.
answers: We lack enough clamps to secure the whole border.
items.notes: enough + 名词 + to do 说明达到用途所需数量。

items.zh: 这扇门太窄，轮椅无法通过。
items.en: The doorway is too narrow for a wheelchair to pass through.
answers: The doorway is too narrow for a wheelchair to pass through.
items.notes: too ... for ... to ...；through 保留与 doorway 的关系。

items.zh: 这里需要一个可以安全切割的表面。
items.en: We need a surface to cut on safely.
answers: We need a surface to cut on safely.
items.notes: 不定式与名词为介词宾语关系，保留 on。

items.zh: 谁是最后一个检查锁扣的人？
items.en: Who was the last person to inspect the clasp?
answers: Who was the last person to inspect the clasp?
items.notes: the last person 后用不定式作定语。

items.zh: 他把眼镜取下来，以便更靠近查看划痕。
items.en: He removed his glasses to examine the scratch more closely.
answers: He removed his glasses to examine the scratch more closely.
items.notes: to do 表目的，逻辑主语与主句相同。

items.zh: 为了不遮住出口，展台被移到了墙边。
items.en: The stand was moved against the wall so as not to obstruct the exit.
answers: The stand was moved against the wall so as not to obstruct the exit.
items.notes: so as not to 表否定目的；not 放在 to 前。

items.zh: 我们需要找一个能商量这个问题的人。
items.en: We need someone to discuss this problem with.
answers: We need someone to discuss this problem with.
items.notes: with 不能省略，因为 someone 是 discuss ... with 的对象。

items.zh: 这是一个重新审视采购方式的机会。
items.en: This is an opportunity to reconsider how we purchase supplies.
answers: This is an opportunity to reconsider how we purchase supplies.
items.notes: opportunity 后接 to do 说明机会内容。

items.zh: 我把备用灯放在近处，以便发生故障时使用。
items.en: I kept a spare lamp nearby to use in case of a failure.
answers: I kept a spare lamp nearby to use in case of a failure.
items.notes: to use 表用途；in case of + 名词表预防情形。
